title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: One runnable, Spanish-language staff ERP prototype for the synthetic Clínica Dental Andina. A single responsive shell connects cash flow, simulated payments, fictional patient records, appointments, clinical overview, inventory and in-memory settings. Self-contained HTML; no production application changes.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Unified business workspace; simulated data, no real backend
